g.desc: Issue87 / PR88. Not for fabrication. No PCB or footprint qualification.

g.text: R8 is in the ramp-capacitor branch only. Q1/Q2 share SOURCE/GATE; intrinsic diode cathodes face outer drains.

g.desc: R8 is in the ramp-capacitor branch only. Q1/Q2 share SOURCE/GATE; intrinsic diode cathodes face outer drains.

g.text: Place at U1 VIN/Q1 drain. Pulse and layout qualification remains open.

g.desc: Place at U1 VIN/Q1 drain. Pulse and layout qualification remains open.

g.text: R1 || R10 =6.667mOhm nominal. Both sense connections require shared Kelvin endpoints; no fuse coordination is established.

g.desc: R1 || R10 =6.667mOhm nominal. Both sense connections require shared Kelvin endpoints; no fuse coordination is established.

g.text: RETRY=GND latches forward OC; UV/OV and U3 automatically recover. SHDN_DIV service reset is NOT ARM or emergency stop.

g.desc: RETRY=GND latches forward OC; UV/OV and U3 automatically recover. SHDN_DIV service reset is NOT ARM or emergency stop.

g.text: See README.md, pins.md, fault-review.md and source-bound calculations. Zero ERC is connectivity evidence only.

g.desc: See README.md, pins.md, fault-review.md and source-bound calculations. Zero ERC is connectivity evidence only.

g.text: OPEN GATES: hot insertion, source surge energy/impedance, diode/MOSFET SOA and thermal, converter startup/dropout/efficiency.

g.desc: OPEN GATES: hot insertion, source surge energy/impedance, diode/MOSFET SOA and thermal, converter startup/dropout/efficiency.

g.text: Output regeneration/12.6 V servo limit, C1 ripple, solder/copper and physical fit remain unqualified. No energization authorized.

g.desc: Output regeneration/12.6 V servo limit, C1 ripple, solder/copper and physical fit remain unqualified. No energization authorized.

g.text: 15-20.5 V stand / 30-42 V steady BUS. Source transients are unknown.

g.desc: 15-20.5 V stand / 30-42 V steady BUS. Source transients are unknown.

g.text: PAN SUPPLY CANDIDATE B | UNSELECTED / UNQUALIFIED | NOT FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION

g.desc: PAN SUPPLY CANDIDATE B | UNSELECTED / UNQUALIFIED | NOT FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION

g.text: U2-only tap. Shared C2/C3 BUS bypasses this sheet; existing D8/D14 and head fuse receive NO protection credit.

g.desc: U2-only tap. Shared C2/C3 BUS bypasses this sheet; existing D8/D14 and head fuse receive NO protection credit.

g.text: No extra PCB, power junction, external solder pad or carrier area allocated.

g.desc: No extra PCB, power junction, external solder pad or carrier area allocated.

g.text: Series D1 blocks raw negative BUS; D2 limits local negative coupling.

g.desc: Series D1 blocks raw negative BUS; D2 limits local negative coupling.

g.text: VIN_PROTECTED >= -2 V and PAN_INPUT <=55 V are test acceptance bounds,

g.desc: VIN_PROTECTED >= -2 V and PAN_INPUT <=55 V are test acceptance bounds,

g.text: not guaranteed waveforms. Charged-output VIN-VOUT >= -57 V in that envelope.

g.desc: not guaranteed waveforms. Charged-output VIN-VOUT >= -57 V in that envelope.

g.text: 12V_PAN feeds existing F1 PAN PTC and F4 pendant/NE555 path.

g.desc: 12V_PAN feeds existing F1 PAN PTC and F4 pendant/NE555 path.

g.text: Four C0G capacitors slow the U1 ramp; verify actual slew and Cin.

g.desc: Four C0G capacitors slow the U1 ramp; verify actual slew and Cin.

g.text: U3 actively pulls EN low until PAN_INPUT exceeds ~13 V.

g.desc: U3 actively pulls EN low until PAN_INPUT exceeds ~13 V.
